title: A manual record share to a user id that does not exist is accepted (201) and persists an inert sys_record_share row
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Reproduction (b914e724, showcase, stock single posture, admin@objectos.ai):
1. POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email (Origin: http://localhost:PORT) as admin.
2. GET /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry → pick any id, e.g. the seeded status='new' inquiry.
3. POST /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry/<id>/shares  body {"recipientType":"user","recipientId":"nobody_xyz","accessLevel":"read"}

Expected: a 400/404 refusal naming the unknown recipient (the grant names no principal, so no gate will ever match it — the same "share row that looks granted and enforces nothing" class #3865 closed for typo'd access levels and ADR-0111 D7 closed for non-user recipient types).
Actual: 201 with {"id":"shr_…","recipient_type":"user","recipient_id":"nobody_xyz","access_level":"read","source":"manual",…}; the row persists in sys_record_share and is listed by GET /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry/<id>/shares.

Contrast at the same door: recipientId "" → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED "recipientId is required"; unknown record id → 404 NOT_FOUND.

Mechanism: packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts grant() (~line 1913-1950) validates presence of recipientId, the recipient type and the access level, but never resolves the recipient against sys_user (or its organization membership).

Reproduced twice on fresh boots (share.db and share2.db, :41162; recipientId 'nobody_xyz' read, 'ghost_user_qa' edit — both 201, both listed by GET …/shares).

Regression: not new since 18.4.0 — `git log 181ad7d4..HEAD -- packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` is empty; the same presence-only check sits at line 1919 at 181ad7d4.

Duplicate search (read-only, none found): `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open share recipient nonexistent user`; `… is:issue is:open record share unknown recipientId`; `… is:issue share recipient validated user exists`.

Severity: low (admin/owner-only door; no access is widened). Data-integrity / inert-grant class.

QA-source: #33910 · access-security.sharing-rules-widen · observed beside the clauses
